answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS approval_rate FROM cases WHERE visacls::text = 'H-1B'

SELECT CASE WHEN ca.docketkey IS NOT NULL THEN 'With Attorney' ELSE 'Self-Represented' END AS representation_status, COUNT(*) AS total_applications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS certified_applications, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS approval_rate FROM cases c LEFT JOIN case_attorney ca ON ca.docketkey = c.filekey GROUP BY 1

SELECT a.attorney_profile->'highest_court'->>'state' AS jurisdiction_state, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS certified_cases, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate FROM case_attorney ca JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey JOIN attorney a ON a.lawmail = ca.counselmail GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY success_rate DESC, total_cases DESC LIMIT 3

WITH w AS (SELECT TO_DATE(beginday, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS b, TO_DATE(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS r, (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(beginday, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(beginday, 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) - (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD'))) AS md FROM cases) SELECT CASE WHEN b < r THEN 'After Start Date' WHEN md = 0 THEN 'Same Month' WHEN md BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 Months Before' WHEN md BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Optimal Window (4-6 Months)' ELSE 'Early Filing' END AS filing_window, COUNT(*) AS application_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM w GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY application_count DESC

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT wsstate, COUNT(*) AS app_count FROM case_worksite GROUP BY wsstate), nat AS (SELECT AVG(app_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT sc.wsstate AS hotspot_state, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_hotspot_states FROM state_counts sc, nat WHERE sc.app_count > 1.5 * nat.avg_count ORDER BY sc.app_count DESC, sc.wsstate

WITH av AS (SELECT ca.counselmail AS atty, c.visacls::text AS vc, COUNT(*) AS type_cases FROM case_attorney ca JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey GROUP BY 1, 2), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visacls::text) AS all_types FROM cases), per_atty AS (SELECT atty, SUM(type_cases) AS total_cases, COUNT(*) AS visa_types_handled, MAX(type_cases) AS dominant_cases FROM av GROUP BY atty), scored AS (SELECT p.atty, p.total_cases, p.visa_types_handled, 1 - p.visa_types_handled::numeric / t.all_types AS asi, p.dominant_cases * 100.0 / p.total_cases AS dominant_pct FROM per_atty p CROSS JOIN tot t WHERE p.total_cases >= 5) SELECT CASE WHEN dominant_pct > 80 THEN 'Specialist' WHEN visa_types_handled BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Hybrid Practitioner' ELSE 'Generalist' END AS specialization_category, COUNT(*) AS attorney_count, ROUND(AVG(asi), 2) AS avg_asi, ROUND(AVG(dominant_pct), 2) AS avg_dominant_pct FROM scored GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY attorney_count DESC

WITH ind AS (SELECT e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' AS naics_code, COUNT(*) AS total_applications FROM cases c JOIN employer e ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm AND e.zipref = c.homezip GROUP BY 1) SELECT naics_code, total_applications, ROUND(total_applications * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_applications) FROM ind), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM ind WHERE total_applications * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_applications) FROM ind) > 15 ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC

SELECT visacls::text AS visa_class, AVG(TO_DATE(decisionday, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS avg_processing_days FROM cases WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED' AND decisionday IS NOT NULL AND decisionday <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC
